findings.detail: Rows 30 and 31 are separate source positions with the same issuer, asset type, rate, and maturity but different footnotes and amounts, so a position key that collapses them is not unique.

rationale: B02 reports 49 duplicate position keys, with Truck-Lite Co., LLC as the example. Raw SOI table 37 shows adjacent Truck-Lite First Lien Term Loan rows that share issuer, instrument type, spread, interest rate, and maturity, but carry different footnotes and different par/amortized cost/fair value amounts. The filing total anchor ties at 1,665.503 million, so this is not an aggregate fair-value residual; the defect is that the extracted position key is too coarse and collides across distinct source rows.
